title: Reliance Industries Q1 Results: Profit Rises 15% to Rs 19,000 Crore
content: Reliance Industries (RIL) reported a strong set of numbers for the first quarter. The company's net profit rose 15% year-on-year. Revenue from the O2C segment saw a significant jump.

title: TCS Dividend 2026: Board Approves Interim Dividend of Rs 28 per share
content: Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) today announced that its board has approved an interim dividend for the financial year 2026-27. The record date has been set for next week.
